meta.title: Escalation Timeout (Hours): dependency on DoA Threshold Currency does not apply when "Only matters when DoA matrix thresholds trigger escalation" is false (DEP-006)
gaps: Configure the Escalation Timeout (Hours) setting or escalation policy while leaving DoA Threshold Currency unconfigured.
Exercise Escalation Timeout (Hours) and verify that the missing DoA currency does not affect its behavior.
Verify the stated amount-based escalation routing impact does not occur.
